claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.holding_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The unit fits MagicItemRecord with PassiveMechanics, and both mechanical riders fit existing atoms, but the passive grant must be gated on actively holding the shield. The current EquipmentPredicate variants only cover always-on, wearing armor, or wielding weapon states.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While holding this Shield, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks."
